title: Canada › Story › Intro
intro: The way in (story/films/intro.ts), on Ottawa's frozen canal. About 40 seconds, hold the button to skip.

flags.text: This is Canada! In winter, the water turns to ice.
Bonjour! I am Maple. I love hockey!
That's the Maple Cup. I want to win it so much!
Honk honk! Geese win the Cup every year!
Last winter, I played all by myself.
Six geese, one beaver! Honk honk honk!
I can't win alone. I need a team!
My friends live all across Canada. Will you help me find them?
Let's go and find Maple's team!

script.text: This is Canada! In winter, the water turns to ice.
script.when: The canal from high up, Maple skating alone with a puck.

script.text: Bonjour! I am Maple. I love hockey!
script.when: Maple, close: a wave and a twirl.

script.text: That's the Maple Cup. I want to win it so much!
script.when: The golden cup on its stand in the snow.

script.text: Honk honk! Geese win the Cup every year!
script.when: The geese skate in, in a V, Gus at the front.

script.text: Last winter, I played all by myself.
script.when: The memory (the storybook look): last winter, six geese round one little beaver.

script.text: Six geese, one beaver! Honk honk honk!
script.when: Still the memory: pucks pile up in Maple's net, she sits down on her tail.

script.text: I can't win alone. I need a team!
script.when: Now again. Maple droops, then stands up straight.

script.text: My friends live all across Canada. Will you help me find them?
script.when: She points one way, then the other, then to the camera.

script.text: Let's go and find Maple's team!
script.when: Sparkle's balloon comes down behind her.
